trigger: Boarding the Ironwood MRAP before the convoy.

nodes.speaker: kessler
nodes.text: [Loudspeaker] Eleven thousand tons feeds Philadelphia for nine days. Load up.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: You're the lineworker. Ruiz. Engineer. You touch the cabinet, I cover you.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: That's the whole plan. Questions, keep them short.

choices.text: You believe the nine days thing?

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: I believe Philly's eating rats. I believe this town's next. Both true, ma'am.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: El Paso. Mom, sister. Haven't heard since October. Don't— yeah. Mount up.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The MRAP rolls. ROUTE 9 is a black line through the snow. A drone whines overhead.
